description: Five segments plus a text label ("Strength: Fair") for a 0-4 score. The segments are visual only; the label carries the information. Colours follow one monotonic scale from the status tokens: very weak destructive, weak a destructive/warning mix, fair warning, strong and very strong success (very strong adds a decorative check icon, aria-hidden). The root is an aria-live="polite" region, so screen readers announce the new label when the score changes.

announcements: Announces the label politely when it changes, e.g. "Strength: Strong".
screenReader.notes: Live updates fire on every score change while typing; polite announcements queue behind the typed characters. Link the meter to the password input with aria-describedby so the strength is read when the field gets focus.

contrast.text: Label prefix in text-muted-foreground (above 4.5:1). The level word uses text-destructive (light 5.5:1 on background / 5.7:1 on card; dark 5.5:1 / 5.0:1), text-warning (light 5.7 / 5.9; dark 10.5 / 9.5) or text-success (light 5.0 / 5.2; dark 9.6 / 8.7). With a custom formatLabel the consumer owns the colours.
contrast.ui: Segments are decorative; the unfilled ones use bg-border. Color is never the only cue: the label always states the level and the number of filled segments grows with it.

motion.reducedMotion: Only a short background-color transition on the segments.

consumerResponsibilities: Provide translated levels (and formatLabel) for non-English UIs.
Add aria-describedby on the password input pointing at the meter's id.
Explain requirements in text; the meter shows strength, not why a password is rejected.
